name: Heartless Killers
source:
This is a science fiction which was modeled on the war between Germany and the Soviet Union during WWⅡ.
Two characters meet, who are remodeled their bodied for combat.

[from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23772]Freem![/url]]

这是一部以二战期间德国和苏联之间的战争为蓝本的科幻小说。
两个角色相遇，他们为了战斗而重塑了身体。
